transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

I... well, I came because of church. I guess I've been doing some things that aren't quite right. Like... standing by the food with the serving spoon just up in the air. Not moving. Or... folding the same stack of napkins over and over when people are waiting. I don't know why.
When you keep folding the napkins over and over, does it feel like something bad will happen if you stop?
No... no, it's not like that. I don't feel like anything bad is going to happen. I just... I don't know. I'm just folding them.
Do you ever hear voices that other people can't hear?
No... I don't hear anything like that. Just regular people talking.
Have you often found it hard to understand other people’s facial expressions or tone of voice?
No... I don't think so. I understand folks just fine. I haven't really had any trouble with that.
When you’re standing still with the serving spoon in the air, if someone gently moves your arm, does it stay in the new position?
I... no. I don't think so. Nobody's moving my arm around. I just... I don't know about that.
When someone tries to get you to move during those frozen moments, do you find yourself resisting the movement?
I don't... no. I ain't fighting nobody. Mostly folks just let me be. I don't really pay much mind to it.
Do these freezing spells tend to happen when you’re feeling stressed or upset?
I... I don't rightly know. I ain't really one to get all worked up. It just... happens when it happens, I guess. I don't really keep track of all that.
Have you found yourself talking much less than you used to?
I... I don't know. I reckon I talk as much as I need to. Ain't got much to say most days anyway.
Have you found that you no longer enjoy things you used to enjoy?
I suppose... I don't really think about it like that. I just do what needs doing. Ain't much for hobbies and such anyway.
When those frozen spells happen, do you remember what was going on around you?
I... well, I ain't exactly sure. I don't really pay it much mind when it's happening. Just... don't remember much of anything, I suppose. It just passes.
Do people tell you that your face looks blank or that your voice sounds flat?
I... no. Nobody's said nothing like that to me. I don't see a whole lot of folks to begin with, so... my face is just my face, I reckon.
When you're having one of those frozen spells, can you still hear and understand people talking to you?
I... couldn't rightly say. Like I told you, I don't remember much of it. If folks are talking... I ain't sure if I hear 'em or not. I just don't know.
During one of these frozen spells, do you feel aware of what’s happening around you?
I... well, no. It's like I was just saying, I don't really know. It's just... blank. I ain't paying attention to what's around me when it happens, so... I couldn't really tell you.
When this happens, does it feel like something outside you is controlling your body?
I don't... no. It ain't like that. I'm just... stuck, I guess. Nobody's controlling nothing.
Have you had a strong sense that people are trying to harm you or plot against you?
No... I ain't had nothing like that. Nobody's plotting against me. I just... I keep to myself mostly.
Have you ever felt like thoughts were being put into your mind by someone or something else?
No... I don't get that. My thoughts are just mine. I don't know what you mean by that, really.
During one of these frozen spells, do you later find that you cannot remember what happened during it?
No... I remember. I just... I'm just sitting there. I know what's going on around me. I just ain't moving.
